page_title: NAP 2-1 CAG | Napoli v Cagliari 16/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle as Alessandro Zanoli (Napoli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90+6' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.

90+2' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
90+1' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is booked.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Walter Mazzarri prepares a substitution. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli).
90' We are about to witness a substitution. Alessandro Zanoli (Napoli) is replacing Matteo Politano.
89' Tommaso Augello finds the head of Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) with a clever free kick, and he crashes in a powerful close-range header at goal that just flies over the bar. Unlucky!
88' A yellow-coloured card is received by Matteo Politano (Napoli).
85' Mario Rui (Napoli) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
84' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
82' A substitution has been made. Victor Osimhen is replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Napoli).
82' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Matteo Politano (Napoli) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
79' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a change. Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) replaces Edoardo Goldaniga.
79' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

75' 2 - 1 Victor Osimhen is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the left post to make the score 2:1.
74' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Matteo Politano (Napoli), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
74' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

74' This shall not pass! Matteo Politano (Napoli) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

72' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Zito Luvumbo, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari), who beats Alex Meret with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 1:1.
69' 1 - 0 Mario Rui produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box where Victor Osimhen (Napoli) rises high to head the ball off the woodwork into the right side of the goal. The score is now - 1:0.
68' Substitution. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) on for Gaetano Oristanio.
67' Here is a change. Nahitan Nandez is going off and Claudio Ranieri gives the last tactical orders to Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari).
66' The corner from Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is hurriedly cleared.
65' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) serves up a nice cross, but Simone Scuffet punches the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Napoli.
64' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Simone Scuffet, who smothers the ball.
64' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
63' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jens Cajuste departs the field of play to be replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
59' Substitution. Mario Rui (Napoli) in, Natan out.
57' The flag is raised and Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is offside again, not for the first time today.
55' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
54' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
54' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Juan Jesus (Napoli) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
51' Juan Jesus (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
50' Juan Jesus (Napoli) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.

46' What a wasted opportunity by Adam Obert (Cagliari)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Alex Meret makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) is replaced by Adam Obert.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Claudio Ranieri gives a chance to Alessandro Deiola and Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Matteo Marcenaro has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+5' Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal!
45+4' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45+3' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) gets a yellow card.
45+2' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Edoardo Goldaniga (Cagliari) for his blatant foul.
45+1' The game is interrupted now, Natan (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' That's all for today as the game is over.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marcenaro and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
44' A quickly taken corner by Napoli.

43' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Alex Meret leaps like a salmon to deny him.

43' Matteo Politano (Napoli) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box. Jens Cajuste (Napoli) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
42' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) is penalised for holding. Matteo Marcenaro signals a set piece. Napoli earn a free kick.

38' What an opportunity! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the right side of the goal, but Simone Scuffet reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
36' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
35' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
34' Close! Jens Cajuste (Napoli) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.

29' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick into the box and attempts to score with a header. His effort is not accurate enough and bounces away off the left post.
28' Matteo Marcenaro blows the whistle, Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) is penalised for a foul. Napoli have a free kick from a promising distance.
28' The total number of attempts is 6:3. The shots on goal statistics – 2:0.
25' Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
23' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
22' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
22' Wasted opportunity. Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
22' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
20' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Simone Scuffet intercepts the ball.
20' Napoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
20' Matteo Politano (Napoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Napoli are going to take it.
18' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
16' Matteo Politano (Napoli) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires a low shot from the edge of the box to the middle of the goal, but Simone Scuffet is equal to it.
15' The corner from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is intercepted by the defence.
15' The ball is cleared after Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Napoli.
14' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
13' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Napoli was in an offside position.
11' Neat link-up play between Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) and Gaetano Oristanio, but Alex Meret reads the game well and the move breaks down.
10' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) misses a big opportunity to score after striking the ball wide of the right post.
8' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. Simone Scuffet is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
7' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Victor Osimhen, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
5' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
5' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) does well to connect with the resulting set piece, but his shot flies high over the crossbar.
4' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
1' Napoli will kick the game off.
1' The match will be delayed.
Matteo Marcenaro will supervise the game today.
